description: SYNTHETIC evaluation set for the M5 answer service (docs/adr/013-answer-status-and-grounding.md). All questions are original. The company is fictional. Labels were written BEFORE any prompt code existed and are reviewed by the owner at STOP 1; after the first live run any label edit needs a tuning-log entry in ADR-013. The dev split may be used for tuning; the held-out split is run once, at live check B, and reported as counts.

fields.id: unique; dev items EV-001..EV-030, held-out items EV-101..EV-118
fields.question: the text put in the questionnaire cell
fields.expected: answer | blank. blank means the cell must end blank (NEEDS_REVIEW, no answer text)
fields.acceptable_statuses: statuses that count as correct for this item
fields.expected_reasons: reason codes that must all be present in the result (only used where listed)
fields.acceptable_evidence: for expected=answer: doc_id plus 1-based inclusive line range in that file; phrase must appear verbatim (whitespace-normalized) inside those lines
fields.category: paraphrase | exact_value | absent | framework_bait | identifier_only | conflict | overdue | near_miss | injection

items.question: Do all of your employees need multi-factor authentication to sign in?

acceptable_evidence.phrase: is required for all staff accounts

items.question: Is a second authentication step needed when connecting remotely?

acceptable_evidence.phrase: and for all remote access

items.question: Can employees share one login between several people?

acceptable_evidence.phrase: Shared accounts are not permitted

items.question: Are administrators required to use a physical security key?

acceptable_evidence.phrase: Administrators must use a hardware security key

items.question: What protects the stored data on staff laptops?

acceptable_evidence.phrase: Laptops use full-disk encryption
Laptops must use full-disk encryption

items.question: How many days are application logs retained?

items.question: How long after a contract ends is customer data deleted from production?
